test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states has the lowest female literacy rate as per Census of India 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan** has the **lowest female literacy rate **as per the Census of India 2011.
 
• The state recorded a female literacy rate of **52.66%**.
 
• The female literacy rate in Rajasthan is significantly lower compared to other states, highlighting the gender disparity in education.
 
• Efforts have been made by the government to improve literacy rates, but challenges such as socio-cultural factors and lack of infrastructure still persist.
 
• Improving female literacy is crucial for the overall development and empowerment of women in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Census of India** is conducted every ten years and provides comprehensive data on various demographic parameters, including literacy rates.
 
• The literacy rate is a crucial indicator of social and economic development in a region.
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, the **national average female literacy rate was 65.46%**.
 
• States with higher literacy rates tend to have better health outcomes, economic productivity, and social development.
 
• Various government schemes and programs aim to boost literacy rates, especially among women, to bridge the education gap.
